Questions

I set a clear delivery schedule before editing starts, work in milestones and flag missing assets early so the timeline stays predictable.

You receive progress updates at the agreed milestones, with review links whenever feedback is needed.

Pricing depends on video length, footage volume, motion-graphics complexity and turnaround. Send a brief and I’ll quote the project clearly.

I use a repeatable review process for pacing, audio, typography, color and export quality before every delivery.

I focus on the story and viewer experience first, then use effects only where they improve clarity, emotion or retention.
